boundary_map.custody: Parent-owned names/descriptors remain outside the attempt; setup-only APIs and sole CAS unchanged.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Setup refusal, malformed handoff, fd-enumeration/fcntl/exec failure and complete per-call inheritance receipts. Early child returns121/122 have no completed envelope.
boundary_map.obtained: All retained processes pass the selected setup checks; real directory fstat receipts are present.
boundary_map.source_rule: Same-Linux parent owns fresh private directory and report capabilities. Child validates inheritance, complete fixed table/context, directory identity and authored model setup before ac_run.

boundary_map.custody: Failed validation would retain saved fd/HeldUnvalidated and supply {-2,7104}; engine halts incomplete. Parent currently lacks creation_identity_available and refuses normal observer/unlink. Descriptor cleanup is not path cleanup.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Native query failure, identity mismatch, consumed validation refusal and cleanup from HeldUnvalidated.
boundary_map.obtained: Successful validation after every successful provider open; collision makes no descriptor. Full-token corrupt control blocks all three follow-up native operations before narrowing.
boundary_map.source_rule: Successful actual int fd is held before queries. Both fstat and nofollow fstatat are attempted in order; only matching valid identities promote HeldUnvalidated to VerifiedHeld.

boundary_map.custody: A known-failure completion acknowledges selected recorded ordinary returns, not successful persistence, closed-after-error disposition or causation.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Real close failure, short write, EINTR or native sync failure in retained runs.
boundary_map.obtained: Real OPEN -1/EEXIST and WRITE -1/EBADF. Readonly fsync and close both returned0 in both modes. All actual provider and held-cleanup closes returned0.
boundary_map.source_rule: Capture actual raw/error before explicit instrumentation, then separately supply callback values. Returned write error still proceeds to sync and close; no retry.

boundary_map.custody: Prepared callback journal is not outer raw capture; published receipt is not native-call evidence by itself.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Neither case exercises native close error or missing native return.
boundary_map.obtained: Close refusal supplies -1/7102 before any actual close; copied completion has known failure and still-held descriptor is separately closed. Invalid WRITE33 follows actual WRITE32, halts incomplete with no public payload and no attempt sync/close, then held cleanup succeeds.
boundary_map.source_rule: Supplied values have explicit origin distinct from native pairs.

boundary_map.custody: Unknown does not authorize close retry, descriptor reuse, probing or inference that a numeric fd is still owned. Container/process termination is containment, not an acknowledged cleanup receipt.
boundary_map.not_obtained: No live missing-return observation, crash-state export, interruption, signal/nonlocal exit, callback quiescence or recovery. A missing return before freeze cannot export current child state. Parent rejects signal/nonzero/wait failure before parsing the report.
boundary_map.obtained: Only source ordering. All selected native calls returned. The provider report is frozen after ac_run and before external cleanup; the completed child envelope is written after both.
boundary_map.source_rule: Actual close dispatch sets UnknownEntered before the leaf; leaf entered precedes libc and returned follows capture. No later use is eligible.

boundary_map.custody: Report and directory descriptors are acquired before witness entry and remain separate from provider fd. Runner exception kill/container removal is infrastructure handling, not native operation completion.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Short/failed report writes, missing report, malformed envelope, nonzero/signal exits, JSON stream failure and timeout recovery.
boundary_map.obtained: Forty JSON/binary pairs and separate process/read evidence. Envelope cannot acknowledge its own pwrite.
boundary_map.source_rule: Child freezes provider evidence, performs separate cleanup, then writes one same-build binary envelope. Parent requires normal exit0, regular owned exact-size4760 report and one exact pread before acceptance.

boundary_map.custody: Observation uses a newly opened owned observer capability, never the child's potentially closed numeric token. Missing creation identity is a refusal, not permission to invent provenance.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Observer identity/read/close failure, arbitrary external writers, stable namespace under interference, durability or recovery.
boundary_map.obtained: Expected copied/decoy/doubled/empty/collision bytes and no-owner ENOENT. Separate observer fd close is recorded.
boundary_map.source_rule: After accepted termination/report, parent checks fixed name identity then opens separate nofollow observer fd, checks that fd identity, reads at most65 bytes and accepts size at most64.

boundary_map.custody: Separate raw cleanup result and before/after state are required. Returning true completes protocol recording only. Failed close would be UnknownAfterCloseReturn and never retried.
boundary_map.not_obtained: HeldUnvalidated branch, actual cleanup failure, repeated cleanup request, or cleanup after unknown native close.
boundary_map.obtained: Eight actual held-cleanup closes across retained children all0, from VerifiedHeld cases including supplied refusal/invalid result and controls. Public engine snapshot remains unchanged.
boundary_map.source_rule: After frozen provider report, one external disposition may close only HeldUnvalidated or VerifiedHeld with saved nonnegative fd. Unknown/Closed excluded. Protocol bool true does not mean close success.

boundary_map.custody: External supervisor ownership must be explicit for later failure work. A successful child completion does not establish parent cleanup; an unsuccessful export does not license unsafe fd operations.
boundary_map.not_obtained: Unlink/remove/parent-close failure or cleanup after partial setup/wait/report/observer failure. Failure can leave owned names without normal observation/cleanup.
boundary_map.source_rule: Parent rechecks identity before fixed-name unlink and empty-directory removal; separately closes report/directory/root evidence capabilities. Failure label makes no retry or recursive cleanup.

findings.claim: Known held-resource incompleteness and unknown-after-close are distinct; existing supplied close refusal proves only the former.

Successful fd custody is established before post-open validation, but validation failure loses the normal parent path-observation prerequisite. A future extension must separate raw identity evidence from consumed validation and normal acceptance.

The cleanup API's bool return acknowledges protocol progression, while its actual close raw/error and custody state acknowledge the attempted native disposition. The frozen passing oracle accepts only successful eligible cleanup.
Entered/returned fields are recorded source states, not a durable or independently observable missing-return channel. Report export is downstream of ordinary return and cleanup.
Normal child termination and report acceptance are separate. The parent currently refuses abnormal/nonzero exits before report reading; no crash-state salvage or cleanup protocol follows.
All successful provider opens observed3; all actual closes succeeded. Host codegen/ABI checks do not establish real close-error behavior or transitive libc/kernel call counts.

The next justified native-custody extension concerns a known held descriptor after a consumed validation veto, not a manufactured real close error. Actual close-error, missing-return and uncertain descriptor states remain closed.

A signaled wait status is rejected before copying child_status. A nonzero ordinary exit is retained but no binary report is parsed. The passing matrix supplies no abnormal-exit diagnostic completeness.

proposed_controls.mutation: Corrupt only the newly reported actual-versus-consumed query evidence while leaving actual native queries, explicit veto and independent external raw-identity receipt intact.
proposed_controls.safety: No fd, native result used for disposition, path or dispatch mutation; independent trusted identity record still governs observation. One composite oracle owns corrupted report effects.

proposed_controls.mutation: Supply {-1,7104} instead of {-2,7104} after the same held validation veto.
proposed_controls.safety: Unchanged engine records ordinary OPEN failure and completes without write/sync/close. Held cleanup stays separately eligible. One composite owns actual return/public-state differences.

proposed_controls.mutation: Omit the eligible external close and honestly report no attempted native cleanup.
proposed_controls.safety: No unknown/closed-token operation. Fresh child exit may release a still-held descriptor as containment; it must not be recorded as successful cleanup. Parent uses independent raw identity and own observer fd; one composite owns cleanup receipt/disposition.

future_boundary.reason: Targets the unexecuted HeldUnvalidated cleanup branch using an actually successful owned open and successful independent identity queries; never reuses or probes a possibly closed token.
required_contract: Use a separately versioned successor with fresh Linux process/directory/file identities and one explicitly authored consumed-validation veto after successful native fd/name queries. Keep actual native pairs and identities unchanged and distinct from the consumed policy result.

Keep successful fd in HeldUnvalidated through the veto; supply the existing {-2,7104} invalid-domain result. Require actual AC_INCOMPLETE and acquire-visible ActiveIncomplete/no payload; do not read private engine working state.

Reserve and retain a separate immutable raw-identity receipt before the consumed veto for external parent observation. It must prove exact successful native fd/name identities, fixed-name capability and ordinary termination. Never set creation_identity_available or VerifiedHeld merely to bypass refusal.

Freeze precleanup provider evidence; invoke existing held cleanup at most once only because no actual close entered. Retain cleanup raw/error/state separately and require unchanged public engine state. A returned error ends attempts and does not license a retry.

Expected-refusal oracle admits only the designated consumed-validation diagnostic and exact source of supplied {-2,7104}. Actual query errors, mismatches, setup/capacity/argument errors and unrelated infrastructure remain rejected.

Parent observer and fixed-name cleanup remain independently checked after confirmed ordinary termination; child's saved integer is never an observer capability. Reporting and cleanup controls cannot weaken identity or token guards.

Record new source transformations, ABI/report layout and any harness allowance before build; review exact finite selectors and singleton controls independently. No old successful matrix/capture/audit is replayed.
